Assets Folder Structure and Contents
===================================

Assets/
├── Fonts/                # (Empty folder)
├── Images/
│   ├── 112909-red-and-black-blurred-background-vector.jpg   # Background image
│   ├── Analytics.png     # Analytics app icon
│   ├── Calculator.png    # Calculator app icon
│   ├── Calender.png      # Calendar app icon
│   ├── Contact.png       # Contacts app icon
│   ├── Favicon.png       # Website favicon
│   ├── Launchpad.png     # Launchpad app icon
│   ├── List.png          # List app icon
│   ├── Notes.png         # Notes app icon
│   ├── pngimg.com - apple_logo_PNG19680.png # Apple logo
│   ├── Quick Settings.png # Quick settings icon
│   ├── Search.png        # Search icon
│   ├── Settings.png      # Settings icon
│   ├── Siri.png          # Siri icon
│   ├── Spotify.png       # Spotify icon
│   ├── Wallpaper/        # Wallpaper images and videos
│   │   ├── Dynamic/      # Dynamic wallpapers (videos)
│   │   │   ├── tahoe-day/
│   │   │   │   ├── Tahoe-day.light.mp4      # Daytime wallpaper video
│   │   │   │   └── wallpaper.json           # Metadata for tahoe-day
│   │   │   ├── tahoe-landscape/
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-landscape.dark.mp4 # Landscape dark wallpaper video
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-landscape.light.mp4# Landscape light wallpaper video
│   │   │   │   └── wallpaper.json           # Metadata for tahoe-landscape
│   │   │   ├── tahoe-portrait/
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-portrait.dark.mov  # Portrait dark wallpaper video
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-portrait.light.mov # Portrait light wallpaper video
│   │   │   │   └── wallpaper.json           # Metadata for tahoe-portrait
│   │   ├── Static/      # Static wallpapers (images)
│   │   │   ├── tahoe-beach/
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-beach.light.jpg    # Static light wallpaper image
│   │   │   │   └── wallpaper.json           # Metadata for tahoe-beach
│   │   │   ├── tahoe-beach-2/
│   │   │   │   ├── tahoe-beach-2.light.jpg  # Static light wallpaper image
│   │   │   │   └── wallpaper.json           # Metadata for tahoe-beach-2
│   │   └── WALLPAPER_METADATA_TEMPLATE.json # Template for wallpaper metadata
